title: `teploy server siblings <server> --json` envelope: sibling product candidates on a server, as the containers and their images report them (rev 20). Observation only — no probing, no DNS, no credentials; the consumer confirms via each product's own discovery endpoint.

state.description: partial means the container listing or the batched inspect failed: empty arrays are 'unobserved', never 'no siblings'

siblings.description: recognised candidates: teploy products (dash, observe, ship) and the forgejo family, one row per container (a multi-container product app yields several rows; the consumer groups them by its own probe)

unknown_labeled.description: containers carrying a dev.teploy.product value this CLI does not recognise, passed through verbatim — a product newer than the CLI stays visible; the consumer decides what it knows

version.description: hint, in priority order: the container's dev.teploy.version label, the teploy release label when the container belongs to a teploy app, the image's org.opencontainers.image.version; absent when nothing says

app.description: the teploy app name when the container is teploy-managed; absent otherwise

image.description: the image ref docker reports, with a 12-hex image ID resolved to its first repo tag when the facts hold one

host_ip.description: as docker reports the bind: 0.0.0.0 (every interface), :: (v6), 127.0.0.1 (loopback only), or a mesh/tailnet address

port_hints.description: published host binds where the product's discovery endpoint may live; hints, not endpoints

source.description: label: the container's own dev.teploy.product; image_label: the image's; oci_label: the image's org.opencontainers.image.title/source names the forgejo family
